guarantees.claim: The function extracts column idx from the 4x4 byte input matrix in, assigning out[i] = in[i][idx] for i from 0 to 3.

assumptions.claim: idx must be a valid 2-bit binary value (not X or Z) to prevent X propagation in out.
assumptions.cond: When function is called with idx containing X or Z bits.
assumptions.risk: Output out will become X, potentially causing incorrect downstream byte extraction if not masked or detected.
